CyclrOAuthTokenCredential.title: CyclrOAuthTokenCredential
CyclrOAuthTokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: Supply an already issued private console-level Cyclr API OAuth Bearer token, its region and selected account API ID. No exchange, client-secret storage, refresh or token minting occurs. Account-level DataOnDemand, MCP and webhook tokens are distinct and not substitutes for console API grants. Actual expiry/permissions remain Cyclr authority.
